_doc: Every bundled cue, tagged for selection. LOOKUP ORDER: (1) if something real is on screen, MATERIAL wins and mood is ignored. (2) otherwise filter by JOB, then by the reel's MOOD. MOOD is valence x energy, so 'serious' is never one thing: somber (low/negative, e.g. grief) and triumphant (high/positive, e.g. a big win) are opposite corners and must not share a palette or a budget. `neutral` cues have no mood and work anywhere. `tactile: true` means DIEGETIC — only use it when the object is actually on screen. `density` is a CEILING per mood, never a target, and SOMBER IS ZERO: a grief/loss reel gets no sound at all unless the creator asks by name. Register still wins when stricter: a confessional reel stays near-silent whatever its mood. `enabled` lists are in sfx-packs.json and are per-pack; a disabled sound is never deleted. A cue with `enabled: false` is OFF: never place it, never offer it, never count it as a rotation alternate. It stays on disk so it can be switched back on. `same_as` means that cue is THE SAME AUDIO FILE as the one it names, under a legacy name. For the never-repeat rule they are ONE sound: placing both back to back is a repeat, not variety. Prefer the canonical name.

somber.rule: 🔴 LOCKED: a somber reel gets NO sound effects. Grief, loss, a death, a diagnosis, a hard truth — place NOTHING, not one cue, not a soft one, not on the hook. Sound on grief reads as production value applied to someone's pain, and it is the fastest way to make a reel feel manufactured. The ONLY exception is the creator asking for one BY NAME. If she does, the somber cues are there; until she does, silence is not a gap you are filling in, it is the finished treatment. Do NOT offer sound on a somber reel as a suggestion either — say nothing about it.

tender.rule: Warm and low-energy. Soft, single, never stacked.

triumphant.rule: A win, a number, a reveal. These can land, but a win announced four times stops being a win.

tense.rule: Alarm, failure, a hard turn. One hit IS the effect; a second cancels the first.

playful.rule: Spot SFX on every real beat. Never the same file twice in a row.

neutral.budget: governed by the reel's mood, not its own
neutral.rule: No mood of its own — a click is a click. Available to every mood. When `tactile` is set it is DIEGETIC: use it only when the thing is actually on screen.

chime.description: Soft melodic chime — gentle positive beat: success/confirmation or a lighthearted transition. Sync to the visual moment.

mouse-click.description: Mouse click: a quiet, short computer-mouse click. Sync exactly to the on-screen click.

error.description: Negative / error tone — failure state, a 'wrong' beat, or a glitchy interruption.

glitch-1.description: Punchy digital glitch — hard-cut accent or sudden reveal. Trigger on the hit; let the decay bleed into the next shot (J-cut).
glitch-1.disabled_reason: switched off by the creator: not in the library, for her or for buyers

glitch-2.description: Harsh, longer glitch — chaotic / jarring transition or a distorted reveal.
glitch-2.disabled_reason: switched off by the creator: not in the library, for her or for buyers

glitch-3.description: Low-key glitch texture — subtle digital shift, minimal transition that sits under other audio.

impact-bass-1.description: Bass impact hit — logo/hero snap, headline slam. Trigger on the visual landing; decay carries into the next shot (J-cut).

impact-bass-2.description: Bass impact with a short swell — brief anticipation then a deep hit. Place so the peak lands on the reveal.

key-press.description: Single key press — one keystroke / terminal-input beat. Short accent, sync to the typed character.

notification.description: Notification chime — alert, message-in, toast/badge appears. Sync to the element entering.

ping.description: Sharp electronic ping — punchy accent on a key reveal or data point. Sync to the beat.

riser.description: Long cinematic riser (~10s build, peak at the end). Trigger at (climax_time − 10.03s) so it crests exactly on the reveal.

sparkle.description: Bright sparkle / shimmer — magical reveal or 'shine' highlight on a hero element. Sync to the highlight.
sparkle.disabled_reason: switched off by the creator: not in the library, for her or for buyers

typing.description: Typing burst (~1.5s of keys) — keyboard / code typing reveal, text-being-typed beat. Start as the text begins typing.

whoosh-cinematic.description: Cinematic whoosh build (~5.5s) — sweeping scene transition. Align so the swell peaks on the cut.

whoosh-short.description: Short whoosh — quick swipe/slide accent, fast element move, snappy transition. Sync to the motion.

whoosh.description: Punchy whoosh/impact — fast reveal or hard transition accent. Sync to the motion.

pop_whoosh.description: Legacy cue name, resolves to the whoosh file.

comedic-pop.description: A comedic pop: a playful, cartoon-style pop as something appears.

studio-open.description: Studio open: a small, precise pop as text or a card appears.

studio-snap.description: Studio snap: a crisp, short lock-in as something lands in place.

correct-tone.description: A correct-answer tone: the beat where something turns out right.

studio-tap.description: Studio tap: one light tap, for a single click or press on screen.

studio-notification.description: Studio notification: a short, gentle ping for a message or a new piece of information.

cinematic-notification.description: Cinematic notification: a warmer, longer ping with a soft tail.

dishes-clink-1.description: Dishes clinking. Kitchen b-roll, only when dishes are on screen.

dishes-clink-2.description: Dishes clinking, a second take. Only when dishes are on screen.

microwave-door.description: A microwave door opening. Only when it is on screen.

thud.description: A thud: something lands with weight.

hit-tap-2.description: A hit with a tap on top, lighter.

soulful-click.description: A soulful click: a warm, rounded click.

hit-1.description: A soft hit: an accent when something lands.

hit-2.description: A soft hit, a second take.

paper-1.description: Paper. Only when paper is on screen, or as a paper-style reveal.

bell.description: A bell ring: a message or a small win.

retro-bell.description: A retro bell: a long, old-fashioned ring.

tap-1.description: A tap: one light touch on screen.

quick-wind.description: A quick gust of wind between shots.

plastic-drop.description: Something plastic dropping: a landing accent.

coin-in-cup.description: A coin dropped into a cup.

plink.description: A bright little plink as something appears.

click-decision.description: A decisive click, for making a choice.

echo-click.description: A click with a short echo.

snap.description: A snap as something locks in.

creaky-door.description: A creaky door. Only when a door is on screen.

tape-peel.description: Tape peeling. Only when tape or a sticky note is on screen.
